author: kycrafft
body:
Brode72 suggested this a long time ago, but I though I should suggest it again. It's not an original kit idea, but it's a fun kit. 

Fashionista
Items: 64 fireworks with every color in the explosion, full leather armor (undyed)
Abilities: none 
Level: 18
Other: You can make fireworks! Also, the leather armor all has protection 1 and unbreaking 3
